Paragraph: Dauntless, bold, and brave are you with sharp lion-like glances, wielding bows like that of Indra you are true enemy destroyers; glorious, splendid, even impetuous like sacred bulls; elephant-trunk-like arms; foremost among men and self-resplendent.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Hanuman continues to admire and describe the martial and physical grandeur of the two princes.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Affirms and honors the strength and valor he perceives, building trust through genuine admiration.
Outcome/Resolution: Strengthens the rapport being built between Hanuman and the princes.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Self-Esteem: Affirmation of strength, valor, and worth

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Hanuman perceives and honors the tejas, the innate radiance and heroic vigor, of Rama and Lakshmana.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Illustrates validating, esteem-affirming language used to build trust and positive regard in a new relationship.
